overview_description.description: Consus is a construction business with a public base. Its primary pursuits include investing in rental properties and building homes both locally and internationally. It makes investments in a range of industries, including agriculture, entertainment, and sports. Both the corporation itself and its subsidiaries are used to run the real estate industry. The group develops and offers increased residential communities while also working in allied businesses to agriculture.
